name: klangwelt-ui
description: Klangwelt user interface: TypeScript without runtime dependencies

scripts.build: tsc -p . && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/changelog.mjs build
scripts.watch: node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/changelog.mjs build && tsc -p . --watch
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run build:web && npm run test:web
